intro: Many guests have never seen a PhD defence — here's what to expect. Short version: it's public, you're warmly welcome, and there's absolutely no obligation to come.

venue.name: Department of Anthropology (Ústav antropologie)
venue.faculty: Faculty of Science, Masaryk University — Budova 2

explainer.title: What happens at a Czech PhD defence?
explainer._comment: Durations below are derived from the confirmed 13:30 start and 16:30 tram departure.

points.a: Yes — it's open to the public and guests are very welcome to watch.
Around three hours, from the 13:30 start through questions to the decision.
After the decision is announced, late afternoon — before we head for the tram.
Straight after — drinks, then we board the party tram at 16:30. It drops us at Železná Růže for dinner at 18:30.
